summary: This is a Form 6-K filing of the minutes of the 2026 Annual General Meeting of JBS N.V., a foreign private issuer. The filing discusses standard meeting procedural items, including a report on financial performance showing record sales of US$86 billion and net income of US$2 billion, a policy on dividend allocation to reserves, and implementation of the Dutch Corporate Governance Code. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. It is a routine annual meeting documentation with no actionable special-situations catalyst.
